1:
<sp(0)><im(1)>The recent attack on Torrington Base has
been confirmed as the work of a
#c[BE5050]Zeon remnant#c organization.
2:
<sp(0)>The #c[BE5050]Zeon remnants<im(2)>#c took, from the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c
ship #c[5E8FD8]Albion#c<im(8)> at dock, the #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2
prototype#c, and they are still on the run.
3:
<sp(0)>Note that #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2<im(9)>#c is armed
with a strategic nuclear weapon banned
by the Antarctic Treaty.
4:
<sp(0)>Should this unit's existence become public,
the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c could not escape
public criticism.
5:
<sp(0)>The involvement of the #c[BE5050]Giganos Empire#c<im(3)> has
also been confirmed, revealing that the two
are working together.
6:
<sp(0)>#c[BE5050]Giganos#c's aims are unknown, but as foes
of the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c, their interests are presumed
to coincide in some way.
7:
<sp(0)>Given how well planned the attack was,
information on #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c
may have been leaked to outsiders,
8:
<sp(0)>and a collaborator inside the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c
cannot be ruled out.
9:
<sp(0)>The intelligence agency #c[E2E258]Preventer#c will
continue to investigate these incidents
and report as appropriate.
